name: personal-project-knowledge
description: Codex adapter for the portable Personal Project Knowledge MCP plugin and skill.

interface.shortDescription: Local memory and Markdown knowledge base.
interface.longDescription: Installs the portable personal-project-knowledge MCP and skills into Codex. The shared skills manage auto-loaded memories, indexed Markdown docs, decisions, requirement changes, preferences, project rules, and safe configuration changes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use personal project knowledge to recall or update memories and project documentation.
